topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can’t believe this. She's just standing there, telling me she doesn’t remember. Us? Building forts in the woods, sharing secrets, planning to save the world? It’s like she’s talking about someone else, or maybe she’s just never really known me. How could she just forget everything? All those years, like they never happened. I don’t get it. It’s like a punch in the gut, and she’s just smiling, oblivious. I should walk away, but I can’t. I need her to remember, to see me. Doesn’t she understand how important this is? How could she not?
